summary: S3Settings — unified settings class for all S3-family providers: AWS S3, S3 Express, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2. Discriminated by FLAVOR: Literal['aws','express','r2','minio','b2']. R2 auto-derives endpoint URL from ACCOUNT_ID via ParameterSpec.template. S3_SPEC is the StorageDescriptor for this provider group.
lifecycle_notes: Consolidated from 5 legacy classes (S3StorageAuthSettings, R2StorageAuthSettings, MinIOStorageAuthSettings, B2StorageAuthSettings, S3ExpressStorageAuthSettings) in Phase 4
Legacy class names removed in Phase 4b — callers must use S3Settings + FLAVOR
documentation_hooks: FLAVOR discriminator is the key concept — document all five flavors with their unique fields
R2: ACCOUNT_ID is required; endpoint URL is auto-derived
S3 Express: bucket naming convention differs from standard S3
risks: FLAVOR validation must catch typos — a wrong FLAVOR silently connects to wrong endpoint
